description: Angular component for a CSS editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and beautification features, integrated with Ace editor and Angular forms.

classes.name: CssComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a CSS code editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and formatting capabilities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the Ace editor, sets up resize observer, and configures event handlers.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and destroys the Ace editor instance.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the Ace editor when the container size changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the editor value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the editor to read-only mode based on disabled state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the editor content, returns validation errors if any.

methods.name: beautifyCss
methods.description: Formats the CSS code in the editor for better readability.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the model value based on editor content and triggers change propagation.
